mechanism: Both drugs may impair gastrointestinal absorption and motility; risedronate requires specific dosing conditions (empty stomach, upright position) while berberine may alter GI pH and transit time, potentially reducing bisphosphonate bioavailability.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; take risedronate on an empty stomach in upright position, and avoid concurrent berberine use or stagger dosing to minimize GI interaction.
